line: Your smart TV isn't just playing what's on. It's watching what you watch — and sending that back.
It can fingerprint what's on your screen, from any device plugged into it.
Some TVs check in four times a minute, on anything you're watching — even from a game console or a set-top box.
A real setting, right in the TV's own menu, turns that off.
It won't stop the ads. It just stops them learning from your own screen.
The setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for the setup that actually works.
